$comment: The project ladders, in ascending complexity — shared by arduino-legit.mjs and
arduino-wiring-audit.mjs. DATA, not code, so importing one tool does not execute the other's
top-level guard. That is exactly what happened: the audit tool imported the legit tool for this
list and inherited its refuse-to-grade-while-a-run-is-in-flight check, which killed the audit.
A module whose mere loading has side effects cannot be composed.
`ladder` is the set the tools grade by default. Pass `--ladder 2` to grade the second set, or name
project ids explicitly. Each id matches a project in projects.json.
LADDER 2 EXISTS BECAUSE REPEATING LADDER 1 WOULD MEASURE SAMPLING NOISE, NOT SKILL. Ladder 1 covers
digital I/O, PWM, analog-in, non-blocking timing, ultrasonic and I2C. Every ladder-2 project is
chosen for a trap with no analogue in ladder 1 — interrupts and `volatile`, float maths with no FPU,
a load a pin physically cannot drive, quadrature decoding where the ORDER of two edges carries the
information, multiplexed refresh where delay() is visible as flicker, a library whose API changed
between major versions, and a second UART with TX/RX crossing over.

ladder.tests: trivial: one pin, no external part
PWM x3, per-channel resistors, debounced toggle, non-blocking
a real state machine with a latched request
pulseIn with a timeout, the /2 in the formula, tone(), non-blocking beeps
two third-party libraries, fixed I2C pins, NaN handling

ladder2.tests: attachInterrupt on pins 2/3 only, volatile across the ISR boundary, no delay() in an ISR, a RESETTABLE timer
resistance to Celsius via Steinhart-Hart (map() is simply wrong), hysteresis as two thresholds, active-LOW relay
a load a 20 mA pin cannot drive, base resistor, flyback diode, shared ground, PWM through a transistor
quadrature decoding (order, not level), interrupt-driven CLK, OLED at 0x3C not 0x27, redraw only on change
multiplexing and persistence of vision, per-segment resistors, two independent timers, neither a delay()
codes that CANNOT be hardcoded (a learning path is the design), IRremote v2-vs-v3 API, timer conflict with analogWrite
SoftwareSerial because the one hardware UART is USB, TX/RX crossing, 3.3V logic on RX, 9600 vs 38400 AT mode
